This ensures that the correct length is set when diagnostics are not implemented, addressing the bug described in the patch.

```c
if (!sff8472_comp || (sff_diag_type & 4)) {
```
```c
modinfo->eeprom_len = ETH_MODULE_SFF_8472_LEN;
```
Reason:
The condition check for the diagnostic type incorrectly used a hardcoded value (`4`) instead of checking if diagnostics were implemented. This led to the EEPROM length being set incorrectly for SFF 8472 compliant port modules when diagnostics were not supported.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (sff_diag_type & SFP_DIAG_IMPLEMENTED)
```
```c
modinfo->eeprom_len = ETH_MODULE_SFF_8472_LEN / 2;
```
Reason:
The patch updates the condition to correctly check if diagnostics are implemented using `SFP_DIAG_IMPLEMENTED`. It sets the EEPROM length to the full length if diagnostics are supported, and to half the length if they are not, thus ensuring the correct EEPROM length is set based on the actual capabilities of the port module.
